about: A prompt never reads a node that carries profile text through a macro (chapter 5 § 5.8.6). The agent closing places the macro signature, which writes profile.signature, so closing carries profile text; the note reads it. Invalid: the plan's prompt reads it too. Valid: the note alone.
sentences: Node 'plan' reads node.closing.content at line 4, which carries profile text through macro 'signature'; a prompt or a part doesn't read profile text. Read it in a deliverable.
